# GNU libmicrohttpd

A small C library designed to embed an HTTP server into other applications.

**Link:** https://www.gnu.org/software/libmicrohttpd/

## What creators claimed

- Used as the underlying high-performance HTTP server bridged to the Fortran application logic. ([DekgklLJ94l](../reels/DekgklLJ94l.md))
